description:
In this YouTube Shorts, we explain how auto-scaling technology handled more than 82 crore viewers during the T20 World Cup final without crashing the streaming platform. When millions of people try to watch the same event at the same time, most systems would normally fail. But modern cloud infrastructure and auto-scaling technology make it possible to handle massive traffic spikes smoothly.

Streaming platforms like Disney+ Hotstar use powerful cloud services such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) to manage millions of viewers simultaneously. Instead of relying on one server, the video stream is distributed across thousands of servers around the world.

When traffic suddenly increases, auto-scaling automatically launches more servers within seconds to handle the load. Another key technology involved is the Content Delivery Network (CDN), which sends the video from servers closer to the viewer, reducing buffering and improving streaming speed.

In this video, we break down the complete Business Analyst roadmap step by step so you can understand what skills, tools, and knowledge are required to enter this high-demand field.

A Business Analyst acts as the bridge between business teams and technical teams. Their main role is to analyze business problems, identify opportunities, and help organizations make better decisions using data and technology. Today, companies across industries such as finance, healthcare, e-commerce, consulting, and technology are hiring Business Analysts to improve processes and drive business growth.
